program.name: Floor Core Long
program.subject: Core & abs
program.blurb: Long floor core sessions: straight sets, then a circuit, with no gear.
program.about: A long core session on the floor. Each day opens with three moves in straight sets, hollows and planks one day, twists and side planks the next, then a circuit of four more. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II brings harder variations and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Hollow & anti / rotation & side, sets then a circuit, no gear
